title: Module 18: Core Node.js Security, Secrets & Process Hardening (All Chapters)
description: Comprehensive module-level assessment covering all chapters of Module 18: Core Node.js Security, Secrets & Process Hardening.

cards.concept: Security Threat Modeling & Core Defense Fundamentals: Node.js Permission Model Security
cards.question: What capabilities does the Node.js Permission Model (`--permission`) restrict at runtime when enabled?

options.text: It restricts CSS rendering and HTML canvas drawing.
It restricts file system read/write access (--allow-fs-read/write), child process spawning (--allow-child-process), and worker thread creation.
It limits RAM usage to 512MB permanently.
It forces all npm packages to run in strict mode.

cards.explanation: The Node.js Permission Model restricts access to system resources (file system paths, spawning subprocesses, creating worker threads) unless explicitly granted via CLI flags.
cards.codeSnippet:
// Launch with restricted file system and no child processes:
// $ node --permission --allow-fs-read=/app/public app.js
cards.pitfall: Relying on software sandboxes without OS-level container isolation (e.g. non-root Docker, dropped Linux capabilities).
cards.citation: Node.js Official Documentation: Permission Model

cards.concept: Security Threat Modeling & Core Defense Fundamentals: Prototype Pollution Defense
cards.question: How can an attacker exploit deep object merging to achieve Prototype Pollution, and how is it defended?

options.text: By sending infinite loops in JSON arrays.
By injecting keys like `__proto__`, `constructor`, or `prototype` in unvalidated JSON payloads, mutating `Object.prototype` for all objects in the runtime.
By exhausting the TCP connection pool.
By using invalid SSL certificates.

cards.explanation: Prototype pollution occurs when recursive merge functions copy properties onto __proto__, injecting properties onto Object.prototype. Defend by stripping dangerous keys or using Map.
cards.pitfall: Using unvetted npm utility libraries for object cloning without checking for prototype pollution CVEs.
cards.citation: OWASP Prototype Pollution Prevention Cheat Sheet
